title: The pup at twelve, the step
logline: The pup, twelve, at the garage's one step, considering it. A hand at the edge, not helping, then the page's second thing: the hand's shadow already on the step. The page draws the deciding.

panels.composition: An old three-legged dog standing before a single concrete step at a garage door looking at it, a man's hand at the frame's edge held back, the hand's shadow already lying across the step.

characters.pose: a hand, its shadow on the step

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an old three-legged dog standing before a single concrete step at a garage door considering it, a man's hand held back at the frame's edge with its shadow already lying across the step, no words
